reason: Targeted review verified the four unchanged evidence SHA-256 pins and prior full-review hash. The original immutability error is corrected: the ledger is append-only while its balance changes with recorded transactions. That phrasing implies finalization itself ends the count. Both captures define the actual condition as pending or positive ledger balance while not expired or voided; a finalized invoice only ends the count if application depletes the ledger balance to zero. All other original findings, disposition, and Q1/Q2 remain consistent.
